pages.text: The Stack Upgrade increases the amount of items that can be transferred at once. RS2 brings significant improvements to stack handling with better performance and optimized transfer mechanics.
Features:$(li)Enhanced item transfer capabilities$(li)Improved stacking efficiency in RS2$(li)Better compatibility with modded items$(li)Optimized power usage$(li)Works with all RS2 machines

To use the Stack Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption$(br2)RS2's improved stack handling ensures smoother operations.
